estimation_framework.definition_of_done: Develop -> Unit/Integration Test (>= 95% cov) -> Package README.md Update -> Git Push

sprint_governance.naming_policy: All sprints are named after United States nuclear-powered submarines, strictly excluding USS Thresher (SSN-593) and USS Scorpion (SSN-589).
sprint_governance.cadence_invariant: Only one sprint (the active sprint) may exist in the system profile at any given time. Future workloads remain in the backlog.
